Did you know this? 

#usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #chinesemedicineworks #wellnessjourney
transcript: Did you know if you place a small piece of ice at the back of your neck, just below the hairline, and gently lift it, then rest it again for a few quiet minutes, the cold may help calm the nervous system. It can soften tension, slow the signals of discomfort, and invite the body to release its grip on pain, do not force it, do not rush the result, breathe slowly, let the cold wake the body gently, and allow the mind to follow. Sometimes relief comes not by fighting pain, but by giving the body a moment of stillness. If your body has been holding pain for a long time, it may not be asking to be fixed, only to be heard. Time to heal is a gentle journey back to your body, your breath, and your inner quiet. You'll find it in the link in my profile. Take it slowly. Healing does not rush.
